messages:
anna_pm: quick one — putting together an invite cadence + qualifying checklist for the next design-partner cohort. goal: recruit 6–8 partners over 6 weeks who can run an end-to-end integration and provide weekly evals. thoughts?

raj_design: :wave: high level sounds good. question — do we require a technical contact who can implement SDKs, or is pilot with product-only contacts okay?

maria_se: we should require an engineer or solutions lead. past pilots failed when there was no dev bandwidth. suggest mandatory "integration owner" field on the intake form.

anna_pm: agreed — require integration owner. also thinking of a 3-step outreach cadence: in-product nudge -> personalized email -> SE intro call. cadence: day 0, day 3, day 10. open to tweaks.

jordan_growth: add LinkedIn InMail for high-value prospects at day 5. conversion spikes when founder/PM gets a personal note. also recommend a small $500 credit + co-marketing as incentive.

oliver_custops: from customer ops POV: include a short checklist for readiness: 1) legal OK with PoC data flow 2) test dataset available 3) weekly internal reviewer. we can help validate readiness before commit.

lee_legal: flag on NDA vs MSA. for short pilots (<=8 weeks) we can use the standard pilot NDA + data processing addendum. if they want private deployment we escalate to MSA. add a question in intake: "expected data sensitivity (public/internal/confidential)".

maria_se: propose qualifying rubric (simple scoring):
- integration feasibility (0/3)
- data sensitivity fit (0/2)
- likely usage volume (0/2)
- product-team sponsorship (0/3)
Total /10, accept >=7, consider 5–6 with exec sponsor.

anna_pm: love that. i'll add weights. also need to define feedback loop: weekly async notes + one 30m sync per week during sprint 0, then bi-weekly demos during evaluation. all feedback captured in Notion + a shared feedback repo.

raj_design: include a short templated prompt set (10 scenarios) we ask partners to run so we can run regressions and compare quality. worth adding to the intake packet.

jordan_growth: timeline ask: recruiting kickoff next monday, outreach week 1, screening calls week 2, confirmations week 3, onboard week 4. target go-live for cohort partners in week 5. is that realistic?

maria_se: tight but doable if we pre-seed a shortlist. SE team needs 2x heads for onboarding week and 1x for ongoing support. flagging capacity.

anna_pm: noted — i'll push for a one-time budget for SE churn. also need deployment options in offer: hosted API vs dedicated vs private. clarity up-front reduces drop-off.

lee_legal: we should also include a short security questionnaire (SaaS checklist) in the intake. many partners want to know data retention and KMS options.

oliver_custops: success criteria proposal to include in the offer doc:
- integration completed within 3 weeks
- partner runs at least 500 sessions or X tokens (define per use case)
- qualitative improvement on their chosen metric (e.g., support deflection, completion rate) vs baseline
- weekly feedback submitted (>=4 of 6 weeks)
If all met -> case study & testimonial ask.

raj_design: minor ask — ask partners to share a short recorded session showing product flow. speeds up UI/UX analysis.

anna_pm: ok action items:
1) i'll draft the intake form + outreach sequences (day 0/3/5/10) and share by EOD Thu.
2) raj to draft prompt set + request for recorded session by Fri.
3) maria to confirm SE staffing and onboarding template by Mon.
4) lee to draft NDA + security questionnaire snippets by Tue.
5) jordan to prepare outreach copy + incentive wording by Thu.
6) oliver to prepare readiness checklist review workflow by Mon.
deploy-bot: reminder: please link onboarding checklist to #dp-onboarding when ready. :robot_face:

jordan_growth: :thumbsup: i'll start building the email + InMail sequences and share A/B subject lines.

anna_pm: thanks all — aim to have first outreach sent next Monday. posting this as the canonical thread for decisions/questions. ping me if any blockers.

lee_legal: one last note — if partner requests private deployment during pilot, we need sign-off from infra security. flag early.

oliver_custops: also capture timezones in intake form. running pilots across EMEA/APAC needs different meeting windows.

anna_pm: good call. adding timezone field. ok closing thread for now — i'll post the draft intake doc once ready. :sparkles:
